patterns.note: Asymmetric hero section with a large, left-aligned heading and body text, balanced by a detailed, abstract graphic on the right.
A sophisticated palette of deep, desaturated blues and greens for backgrounds, contrasted with crisp white text and subtle, warm accent colors in dynamic graphics.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, while lighter-weight sans-serifs provide clear readability for body copy and smaller labels.
Dynamic particle-based 3D landscapes in the hero and footer sections subtly animate and parallax as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and scientific sophistication.
Accordion-style interactive sections are used to progressively disclose detailed information, maintaining a clean layout while offering depth on demand.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section features a dynamic, particle-based 3D landscape that subtly animates and parallaxes on scroll, creating a sense of depth and engagement, likely implemented with canvas or a similar library.

The header remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its position and slightly adjusting its appearance (e.g., background opacity or blur) after the initial scroll to ensure navigation is always accessible.

Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing the user experience and guiding attention through the page, likely using CSS keyframes or GSAP ScrollTrigger.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with generous line height, paired with smaller, lighter-weight body text for readability and detail.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dynamic, particle-based 3D landscapes as both a hero and footer element creates a sophisticated, data-driven aesthetic. This, combined with the subtle color palette and clean typography, establishes a strong sense of scientific innovation and high-tech expertise, moving beyond typical corporate layouts.
